name: Batch ops: LatentBatch, LatentFromBatch, RepeatLatentBatch, seed behaviour, Rebatch
plain: Batch management. The point of interest is batch_index, the list that controls which noise seed index each sample gets, so these nodes change noise as well as tensors. LatentBatchSeedBehavior "fixed" gives every sample the first index, so all get the same noise.
math:
batch: cat dim0, batch_index concatenated without renumbering
fromBatch: slice; batch_index = range or kept
repeat: x.repeat(amount); batch_index extended with offset = max−min+1
seed fixed: batch_index=[first]·B; random: batch_index removed
rebatch: cat and slice lists to batch_size
label: from code
